How to Access Your Training

1

Check Your Email

We just sent you a portal invite email. Look for an email from Home Run Homes with your login link. Check spam if you don't see it in a few minutes.

2

Create Your Password

Click the link in the email and set up your password. This is your personal login to access the training anytime.

3

Start Watching

Once you're logged in, the full training is right there. Watch at your own pace — it's yours forever.

4

Earn Your Certificate

Complete the training and you'll receive a Certificate of Completion. This shows you're educated and ready to take the next step toward homeownership.
